GROUP EXPECTATIONS

Meet the kind of trip you’ll love.

For travellers aged 19–27, whether joining solo or with friends. Expect shared plans, hosted days and common meeting points; group makeup varies by departure. Respect personal space and agreed timings.

This offer is not a luxury or fully customised trip.

INCLUDED IN ₹12,999

The good stuff, clearly listed

  • 4 nights in shared rooms (2–3 travellers)
  • Group transport from Delhi to Himachal and back
  • Transfers and sightseeing listed in the itinerary
  • 4 breakfasts and 4 dinners
  • 24×7 trip captain and daily photos shared by day’s end
  • All applicable taxes and mandatory trip charges
NOT INCLUDED

Make room for the extras

  • Travel to and from the Delhi departure point
  • Lunches, drinks and meals not listed
  • Optional activities and entry tickets not listed in the itinerary
  • Personal spending, shopping, tips and insurance
  • Private room upgrades, if requested
  • Extra costs from personal delays or itinerary changes requested by you

TRAVEL BETTER TOGETHER

A little consideration
goes a long way.

Everyone deserves to feel welcome, comfortable and included—whether they joined solo or with friends.

✓ Do
  • Invite others into conversations and group plans; leave room for anyone who prefers quiet time.
  • Respect personal space, pronouns, boundaries and different backgrounds.
  • Be on time for departures, and tell the captain early if you need help.
  • Keep shared rooms and vehicles tidy and keep noise low during rest hours.
  • Ask before photographing, tagging or sharing someone else’s image.
× Don’t
  • Exclude, tease, harass or make discriminatory remarks about fellow travellers.
  • Pressure anyone to drink, join an activity, share personal details or appear in a photo.
  • Play loud music or take calls on speaker in shared spaces without the group’s agreement.
  • Take or use another traveller’s belongings without asking.
  • Ignore someone’s discomfort—let the captain know privately if you need support.

Need a hand or feeling uncomfortable? Speak to the trip captain privately.

ILLUSTRATIVE CANCELLATION POLICY

Plans change. Know where you stand.

Cancel before departure. The charge below is a percentage of the trip price after any discount; the rest is refundable.

30+ days100% refundNo cancellation charge
21–29 days75% refund25% cancellation charge
15–20 days50% refund50% cancellation charge
0–14 daysNo refund100% cancellation charge

How it works: Days are counted as calendar days before the departure date in India; departure day is day 0. The charge is capped at the amount paid; refund = amount paid minus the applicable charge. If YatraLoop cancels the trip, you receive a full refund of the amount paid. Approved refunds return to the original payment method within 7–10 business days.

Unavoidable changes, including weather or road closures, will be communicated as early as possible. If the trip is cancelled by the operator, the full-refund rule above applies. This is an illustrative policy for the fictional YatraLoop concept.

03 / THE DECISION LOGIC

Interest is the beginning.
Trust does the work.

From STP to the funnel: a plan built around reassurance and transparency.

A

Choose the person.

SEGMENT → TARGET → POSITION

Indian Gen Z, 19–27. Domestic hosted group trips, ₹7,000–₹25,000: Goa, Himachal, Meghalaya, Rajasthan and North East.

  • First-time solo joiner
  • Budget-conscious planner
  • Warm but undecided waitlist contact

ICP hypotheses, not interview findings.

Position: reassurance and transparency, not lowest price. Exclude blanket youth reach, luxury and fully customised trips.

B

Give channels a job.

Search
Capture existing intent within 30% impression share.
Meta / Reels
Interest + ICP proof tests. Lookalikes are a possible test, with no assumed uplift.
Creators
Authentic explanation. ₹2 lakh/quarter; ₹8 lakh/year inside ₹30 lakh.
YouTube
Existing footage only.
CRM
35,000 opted-in contacts. At most one promotion/month. No paid halo.
C

Respect the drop-offs.

Base Meta media funnel · social interest ≠ booking intent.

Quarterly base / expected versus capacity.

Positioning hypothesis to test · Against MakeMyTrip group packages, Thrillophilia group tours and WanderOn: can a young traveller answer safety, group fit, total cost and cancellation before paying? No competitor prices or policies are assumed.

Meta’s conversion staircase

Media only · test uplift limited to the ₹3 lakh tranche

9.33 million impressions can exceed 6 million reachable audience through repeated exposure. This is not unique reach.

Bookings versus available capacity

Solid = expected · outline = cap · numerical labels show overflow

Paid pacing: 20% / 35% / 15% / 30%. Creators: ₹2 lakh each quarter. Annual mix has one more Q3 CRM promotion than the quarterly base.

Channel economics
ChannelPlanned spendBookingsCACGross ROAS

Creators are a separate cost with no independently attributed bookings. Blended CAC includes creators. CRM costs are unknown and excluded from the stated ₹30 lakh allocation; CRM CAC is unpriced.

CRM concentration is the central planning risk.

Every priced paid CAC exceeds ₹1,667.Search cannot fill capacity at 30% impression share.

ROAS measures gross booking value.It is not profit, nor a choice of Target ROAS bidding.

THE CMO ASK / CONDITIONAL

1,250 travellers.
The same ₹30 lakh.

Ring-fence ₹3 lakh inside the existing ₹14 lakh Meta media for conversion tests. The Year-1 ask is conditional on validated CRM rephasing into spare capacity and/or further conversion gains.

EVIDENCE GATES / EACH QUARTER

  • Unique travellers and booking CAC
  • Funnel by ICP, creative and landing page
  • CRM fatigue and opt-in health
  • Available trip capacity

A new brand may need a bounded maximize-conversions test on a real booking event before Target ROAS bidding is credible.
